title: SM-33
description: SM-33 was a broken-down old droid found aboard the Onyx Cinder, the ship that had crashed on At Attin. With a missing eye, a peg-leg, and a rodent living in his memory circuits, it was a wonder he was able to function at all. He served whoever was the captain of the ship, and when the kids realized this, Fern stepped up to declare herself captain, which SM-33 accepted.
